_comment: Source of the README 'See it work' block and of docs/launch/README.md 'More clips' (scripts/docs/sync_docs.py, blocks `recordings` and `recordings-more`). Edit captions here, never in the Markdown. `featured` (at most 3) are shown in the README, inline as the WebP in docs/launch/media/clips/<id>.webp with the GIF here as its fallback; `more` and every take are listed in docs/launch/README.md (WebP, or the GIF when there is no WebP). scripts/record/launch.sh clips rebuilds the files under the same names.
note: Recorded on the real backend with the real 2026 workbooks, rendered offline at 60 fps (docs/launch/README.md). Instructor names are reduced to initials.

featured.title: Find a room
featured.caption: Head count and a feature. Rooms that fit come first, near fits after, each with its reason.

featured.title: Reserve a free period
featured.caption: Point at a free period, click, confirm. The cell then shows You.

featured.title: Move a class
featured.caption: Only free rooms that fit are offered. The server checks the move before it is saved.

more.title: Book several periods
more.caption: Drag across free periods of one room. One sheet books them together.

more.title: Undo from the audit log
more.caption: A move shows the room before and after. Undo puts it back.

more.title: Pre-check and fix
more.caption: The Studio checks the plan against the term's data and applies one of its fixes.

more.title: Quick reserve on a phone
more.caption: A day, a period, how many people, a free room: one tap books it, and the receipt can undo it.

more.title: Ask for a room that needs approval
more.caption: A room with an approver: the booking is sent as a request, and the approver is told.

more.title: Approve the request
more.caption: The approver opens the request and approves it; the booking is confirmed.

more.title: Start from an empty instance
more.caption: Drop the exam workbook with AI off. It is read, a term is proposed, reviewed and saved.

takes.title: Reservation panel: a click, a drag, room details
Move a class in the calendar, then undo
Studio: a rule from a template, the pre-check and a fix
Book a room with a note, My bookings
Create an account and pick its role
Run report: apply a suggested fix
Quick reserve on a phone (390x844, touch)
A request that needs approval, approved
